description: This file is a Perl module implementing authentication callback functions for use with SVN authentication in the context of 'git svn'. It defines functions for handling simple credentials, SSL server trust, client certificates, and username prompts, with associated helper functions.

methods.name: simple
methods.description: Handles simple username/password authentication, prompting if not available.

methods.name: ssl_server_trust
methods.description: Handles SSL server certificate validation, prompting user to accept or reject based on certificate failures.

methods.name: ssl_client_cert
methods.description: Prompts the user for the filename of the client SSL certificate.

methods.name: ssl_client_cert_pw
methods.description: Prompts the user for the password for the client SSL certificate.

methods.name: username
methods.description: Prompts the user for a username if not predefined.

methods.name: _read_password
methods.description: Reads a password from the user input with a prompt.
